title: Hanso document
description: Metadata for a Hanso-branded document. Everything except `title` is optional; omitted fields use the template's own branded defaults.

title.description: Document title, shown on the cover.

author.description: Author name, shown under the title.

date.description: Document date as YYYY-MM-DD. Defaults to today.

theme.description: Light is the beige brand ground; dark is the navy palette.

footer_style.description: `full` is the three-column address/contact/bank block for external correspondence. `simple` is one line for internal documents.

bank.description: Bank detail lines. Only shown when footer_style is `full`.

support.description: Support address shown in the simple footer.

confidentiality.description: Classification note in the simple footer, e.g. "Internal use only".
